title: dysoxylum rufescens subsp. dzumacense
intro: Dysoxylum rufescens subsp. dzumacense, commonly known as Mindanao rosewood, is a plant species native to the Philippines. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of infections, among others. Bioactive constituents of Dysoxylum rufescens subsp. dzumacense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
